name: TEE Attestation Validation
description: Validates a fresh Android Keystore attestation challenge, certificate chain, trust anchor, revocation status, and RootOfTrust consistency, and compares the attested boot state with the boot-state system properties.

evidenceUnits.title: Keystore attestation chain and RootOfTrust
evidenceUnits.observedObject: A fresh Android Keystore attestation response, certificate chain, revocation snapshot, challenge, and RootOfTrust fields, and the ro.boot.verifiedbootstate, ro.boot.flash.locked and ro.boot.vbmeta.device_state properties
evidenceUnits.proposition: The returned attestation artifacts satisfy or violate the recorded cryptographic and structural validation rules, and a trusted RootOfTrust agrees or disagrees with the boot state the properties claim
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: Android Keystore key generation and offline certificate or extension validation
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on Keystore support, certificate availability, parseable extensions, and bundled trust data
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: Hardware-backed claims originate below the app, while local validation and revocation freshness remain app-managed
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: Local attestation is not equivalent to server-side nonce policy or Play Integrity and may be unavailable on supported devices; an attested boot state that agrees with the properties is what an unmodified device shows and also what an attestation forged for this app next to spoofed properties shows, so agreement is a concealable negative
